Cake is required for breeding. }} '''Breeding Farm''' is a structure in {{PW}}. == Acquisition == The Breeding Farm is a tier 19 ancient [[technology]] structure and costs 2 ancient technology points to unlock. ==Usage== In order to [[Breeding|breed]] the player will need 1 Male and 1 Female Pal assigned to the Breeding Farm, and 1 [[cake]]. Place a cake into the box attached to the Breeding Farm once the two pals are assigned and they will produce an [[Pal Eggs|egg]] over time without consuming sanity. The egg can be hatched at an [[Egg Incubator]]. Pals will produce an egg every 5 minutes, and the breeding time depends on the work speed set by the [[Monitoring Stand]].
